top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, independently confirmed chain from physiology to medicine. Drucker and Holst are the secure core. Knudsen's acylation and half-life extension is the step that turned a peptide lasting minutes into a once-daily or once-weekly drug, so a citation covering discovery of the physiology and development of long-acting therapy is the most faithful account of what reached patients. Mojsov's priority against Habener and others cannot be settled from the supplied material, so P001 is a defensible but less secure second choice. Awarding nothing is clearly worse than either.
